source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of polygenic inheritance, block for block (PDF 96-98).

blocks.text: Polygenic khasiyatein aik nahi balke kai gene joron se control hoti hain. Polygenic inheritance mein kai genes ke sab alleles aik hi khasiyat mein jama (additive) tareeqe se hissa dalte hain: kuch asar barhate hain, kuch ghatate hain. Sab ka mila jula asar aik khasiyat banata hai.

Polygenic khasiyatein aabadi mein farq ka poora silsila dikhati hain, yaani continuous variation (musalsal farq, beech ki bohat si darjaat). Misalein: insanon mein qad (height), jild ka rang, wazan aur zehanat (intelligence), aur paudon mein daane (grain) ka rang.
Insani jild ke rang ki virasat

Jild ka rang melanin pigment ki miqdar par hai: zyada melanin se jild gehri (dark), kam melanin se halki. Yeh khasiyat taqreeban 60 genes (polygenes) control karte hain, lekin samajhne ke liye hum sirf 3 genes lete hain: A, B, C. Har gene ka aik dominant aur aik recessive allele hai.

items: Alleles A, B aur C zyada melanin banate hain.
Alleles a, b aur c kam melanin banate hain.

blocks.text: Agar walidain AABBCC (bohat gehra) aur aabbcc (bohat halka) hon to sab bachche AaBbCc (darmiyana rang) honge. Agar dono walidain triple heterozygote (AaBbCc) hon to bachchon ke rang bohat gehre se bohat halke tak hon ge, aur un ki ratio 1 : 6 : 15 : 20 : 15 : 6 : 1 hogi (gehre se halke ki taraf).

items: AABBCC → sab se gehra (zyada se zyada melanin)
aabbcc → sab se halka (kam se kam melanin)

blocks.alt: Oopar: walidain gehri surkh gandum AABBCC x safaid gandum aabbcc; gametes ABC aur abc; F1 AaBbCc, darmiyani surkh gandum. Neeche: AaBbCc x AaBbCc, har aik aath qisam ke gametes banata hai jo 8 x 8 grid mein 64 genotypes dete hain; har khana dominant alleles ki ginti ke mutabiq gehre surkh se safaid tak rang mein hai. Neeche 63 surkh (mukhtalif rang) : 1 safaid aur saat jamaaton ki ginti.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.7: Gandum ke daane ke rang ki polygenic virasat (kitab ki Figure 18.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jamaatein: Dark red 1, Moderate red 6, Red 15, Intermediate red 20, Light red 15, Very light red 6, White 1.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har khane ka rang us genotype mein bare (dominant) huroof A, B, C ki ginti se hai: 6 bare huroof sab se gehra surkh, 0 safaid. Bare huroof jitne zyada, rang utna gehra. Isi liye 64 khanon mein 1, 6, 15, 20, 15, 6 aur 1 aate hain, aur rang musalsal (continuous) badalta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.7 ke unwan (caption) mein 'what grain colour' chhapa hai; sahi 'wheat grain colour' (gandum ke daane ka rang) hai.
Gandum ke daane ka rang (Wheat Grain Colour)

Gandum ke daane ka rang continuous variation dikhata hai: safaid se gehre surkh tak. Yeh khasiyat teen polygenes A, B aur C control karte hain. Har gene ka dominant allele (A, B, C) surkh pigment banata hai aur recessive allele (a, b, c) nahi banata. AABBCC sab se zyada surkh pigment banata hai, is liye daane gehre surkh; aabbcc koi pigment nahi banata, is liye daane safaid hote hain. Upar wala cross (Figure 18.7) dekhein.

Jab gehri surkh gandum (AABBCC) ko safaid gandum (aabbcc) se milaya jaye to F1 (AaBbCc) darmiyane surkh rang ki hoti hai. F2 mein rangon ka bara silsila aata hai: 64 mein se sirf aik paude ke daane sab se gehre surkh (AABBCC) aur aik ke safaid (aabbcc) hote hain, jab ke 62 paude surkh ke mukhtalif darjon (moderate red se very light red) wale hote hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Mahol ke awamil (environmental factors) jaise roshni, paani aur ghizai ajza (nutrients) bhi daane ke rang par asar dalte hain.

blocks.prompt: AaBbCc × AaBbCc se 64 milap kyun bante hain?
blocks.explanation: Har walid 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 qisam ke gametes banata hai, aur fertilization mein 8 × 8 = 64 milap mumkin hain.

items: Polygenic: kai genes, jama (additive) asar, continuous variation (qad, jild ka rang, wazan, zehanat, daane ka rang).
Jild ka rang: AaBbCc × AaBbCc se 1 : 6 : 15 : 20 : 15 : 6 : 1.
Gandum: AABBCC × aabbcc se F1 darmiyana surkh; F2 mein 64 mein 1 gehra surkh, 1 safaid, 62 surkh ke darje.
